# Municipal Ordinance No. 10, Series of 2024

**An Ordinance Enacting the Gender and Development Code of 2024 of Pitogo, Quezon**

## Summary

This ordinance enacts the Gender and Development (GAD) Code of 2024 for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province]]. It establishes a comprehensive framework for gender mainstreaming in local governance, ensuring the integration of gender perspectives in all municipal programs, projects, and activities. The ordinance was reviewed and declared **valid** by the [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] under SP Resolution No. 2024-1058. This ordinance is complemented by [[MO-02-S2025]], which implements the Magna Carta of Women.

## Key Provisions

- Enacts the Gender and Development Code of 2024 for the municipality
- Establishes a framework for gender mainstreaming across all municipal offices and programs
- Provides for the allocation of the GAD fund in accordance with national mandates
- Creates mechanisms for gender-responsive planning and budgeting
- Defines roles and responsibilities of municipal offices in GAD implementation

## Provincial Review

The [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] of [[Quezon Province]] reviewed this ordinance under **SP Resolution No. 2024-1058** dated November 18, 2024, and declared it **VALID**. The GAD Code was found to be consistent with national mandates on gender and development.
